hero.highlight: Consent for AI starts on your phone
hero.description: Arvify Consent Layer runs as a browser extension and MCP proxy. Every AI request triggers a push on your phone, you approve with Touch ID or Face ID, and data is released only for the selected TTL.

features.localProcessing: Push notification + Touch ID / Face ID
features.hybridCloud: MCP proxy that filters GitHub, Gmail, APIs
features.mobileControl: Set TTL and policies directly from the app
